verdict.rationale: Shortwave's Splits feature divides one inbox into multiple smaller, focused inboxes, each in its own tab. Splits can be defined by importance, built-in labels, custom labels, specific senders, or complex search queries, so users can handle different types of email at different times. That maps directly onto triaging in priority order rather than arrival order, and plain-English AI filters can auto-label mail to feed those splits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ready-made newsletter or calendar-invite streams (only implied via labels and queries), and independent hands-on corroboration of Splits specifically (community praise covers Bundles and grouping, not Splits).
